title: Webhooks contract + signatures
verificationRules: Verify the exact raw HTTP body before JSON parsing or mutation.
Reject timestamps outside the replay window.
Reject malformed signatures and delivery identifiers.
Compare HMAC digests in constant time.
Allow at most current plus previous secret during controlled rotation.
Never log webhook secrets or full signature material.
Duplicate delivery handling must be idempotent by deliveryId at the consumer boundary.
authorityBoundary: Webhook transport is non-authoritative. PostgreSQL remains authoritative for auction state, accepted bids, winner selection and final results.
